title: Wyvern Hunt
description: Three sheep and a plow-ox gone off the Hale farmstead in the eastern hills. A wyvern that has moved from deer to stock does not stop on its own. The guild will not send apprentices.

objectives.description: Kill the wyvern taking stock off the Hale farmstead

notes: Threat: named farm (the Hale farmstead) losing stock to a wyvern that has moved from deer to livestock - a known escalation the guild has seen before. Giver motive: the guild won't risk apprentices on it, so the bounty is paid at top rate for an experienced hunter. Refusal: the Hale farmstead keeps losing stock and the wyvern's pattern of escalation continues.
